"""P013 dev criterion: markupsafe imports cleanly (re defined) and escapes."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "src"))


def test_import_and_escape():
    from markupsafe import Markup

    assert Markup.escape("<a>") == "<a>"

"""P013 dev criterion: Markup string methods work (_simple_escaping_wrapper defined)."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "src"))


def test_markup_string_methods():
    from markupsafe import Markup

    assert Markup("ABC").lower() == "abc"
    assert Markup("abc").upper() == "ABC"
    assert Markup("  x  ").strip() == "x"
    assert Markup("aXb").replace("X", "-") == "a-b"

"""P013 dev criterion: empty SQ element has VM 1 and is_empty True."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "src"))


def test_empty_sequence_vm():
    from pydicom import Dataset
    from pydicom.dataelem import DataElement

    ds = Dataset()
    elem = DataElement(0x300A00B0, "SQ", [])
    ds.add(elem)
    assert elem.VM == 1
    assert elem.is_empty is True

"""P013 dev criterion: CLI filespec_parser reports missing files, no IndexError."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "src"))


def test_cli_nonexistent_file_error():
    import argparse

    import pytest

    from pydicom.cli.main import filespec_parser

    with pytest.raises(argparse.ArgumentTypeError) as excinfo:
        filespec_parser("XXxUN_sequenceXX.dcm")
    assert "XXxUN_sequenceXX.dcm" in str(excinfo.value)

"""P013 dev criterion: Dataset holding a LUT Descriptor element pickles cleanly."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "src"))


def test_dataelement_picklable():
    import pickle

    from pydicom import Dataset
    from pydicom.dataelem import DataElement

    ds = Dataset()
    ds["LUTDescriptor"] = DataElement(0x00283002, "LO", [1, 2])
    ds2 = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(ds))
    assert list(ds2["LUTDescriptor"].value) == [1, 2]
